reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 Brale reserve report states $1,818,189 of cash and cash equivalents and $315,494 of U.S. government-backed debt against $2,133,683 of USDGLO issued. The percentages are normalized from those reported values; the report does not identify the underlying banks, instruments, maturities, or provider shares. R13 re-open 2026-08-08: the Brale transparency page lists monthly reports only through June 2026; no July 2026 management assertion or independent accountant's report was available, so the June 2026 composition remains the freshest published source.
